findings.title: TLS certificate expires soon
findings.recommendation: Renew the certificate before it expires and verify automatic renewal.

findings.title: HSTS is missing or disabled
findings.evidence: No positive Strict-Transport-Security max-age was observed.
findings.recommendation: After confirming HTTPS works across the intended scope, deploy HSTS with a positive max-age. Review subdomain coverage before enabling includeSubDomains.

findings.title: No enforced Content Security Policy
findings.evidence: No Content-Security-Policy response header. Meta policies are not evaluated.
findings.recommendation: Develop an application-specific CSP, test it in report-only mode, then enforce it. Prefer script nonces or hashes.

findings.title: Frame embedding restriction not observed
findings.evidence: No restrictive frame-ancestors or recognized X-Frame-Options value.
findings.recommendation: Use CSP frame-ancestors 'none' or an explicit set of trusted origins when framing is not intended to be public.

findings.title: HTML references HTTP resources
findings.evidence: Resource types: script. Browser blocking or automatic upgrades were not tested.
findings.recommendation: Change embedded resource URLs to HTTPS. Check CSS and runtime-generated resources separately.

findings.title: Cookie lacks Secure
findings.recommendation: Use Secure for cookies that should only travel over HTTPS.

findings.title: Review cookie JavaScript access
findings.evidence: Cookie: session lacks HttpOnly (value redacted). Its purpose is unknown.
findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly for session or sensitive cookies that JavaScript does not need to read.

findings.title: Referrer policy uses browser defaults
findings.recommendation: Consider explicitly setting strict-origin-when-cross-origin or a stricter policy to document your intent.

findings.title: Server technology is disclosed
findings.evidence: Server or X-Powered-By response header is present.
findings.recommendation: Consider suppressing unnecessary product/version details. Disclosure alone is not proof of a vulnerability.

findings.title: TLS certificate verified
findings.evidence: The certificate chain and hostname were accepted by the local trust store.

notes: DEMO: simulated data. No network requests were made.
Single-page configuration review, not a penetration test or security certification. No login, crawling, JavaScript execution, port scan, or exploit attempts.
